maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is transaction fees on payments processed for digital merchants' sales, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumers via carrier billing, wallets and bank payments for digital subscriptions from private merchants like streaming brands.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by adding merchants, markets and payment methods on its platform; only occasional acquisitions, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Single API handles licensed payment processing, settlement and FX for 200+ local methods; switching means re-integration and compliance disruption.
